name: graph-uncertainty-scope
goal: Ignore only graph gaps proven unrelated to every active page during feature impact discovery

evidence: A Work component impact on 42c7 reports six dangling edges and 166 references. Five edges originate in tests and one is a scenario edge; every dangling edge currently makes all references block page discovery.

The existing scoped uncertainty matrix covers dangling unknown origins, but not a missing target reached only from an unrelated test or scenario versus the same gap reached from an active page. Extend that existing matrix without changing its case identity.
